Title: Ayaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ayaan - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Kavya - 12 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Hema - 34 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Nitin - 36 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Ayaan stands in the park. Kavya, Hema and Nitin stand near him.]

Kavya: "What lovely weather!"

[Ayaan throws the ball to Mother.]

Hema: "Oh wow!"

[Ayaan catches the ball.]

Ayaan (surprised): "Hey, look at that!"

[Ayaan plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Hema: "Okay, Kavya."

[Ayaan does yoga on a mat.]

Hema: "Nitin, listen!"

[Kavya skips rope.]

Kavya (laughing): "What next?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Nitin: "Ayaan, look over here."

[Ayaan feeds the dog.]

Ayaan (surprised): "Careful!"

[Ayaan milks the cow.]

Nitin (laughing): "That's great!"

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Hema: "Yes, of course."

[Ayaan pats his horse.]

Hema: "That's easy."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Ayaan stands in the living room. Hema and Kavya stand near him.]

Ayaan: "What a nice place."

[Ayaan irons his school shirt.]

Hema: "Kavya, are you okay?"

[Ayaan writes in his notebook.]

Kavya (happily): "Show me too!"

[Ayaan does his homework at the table.]

Hema: "That's easy."

[Ayaan flops down on the sofa.]

Ayaan: "Show me too!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Night

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Hema and Kavya stand near him.]

Hema: "Ayaan, look over here."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Hema: "Ayaan, listen!"

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Kavya: "What a day to remember!"
